hypotheses.name: Founding hypothesis - retained asymmetry / motion coherence (J-M Effect)
hypotheses.statement: Sequential processing (temporal state carried forward) should produce smooth, Newtonian, temporally-consistent motion inference; block-universe processing (all frames co-present) should produce erratic, non-Newtonian discontinuities.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Matched trials: same footage, same model, true sequential delivery vs. full block access; measure motion-coherence signatures. Statistically indistinguishable signatures = H1 falsified.
hypotheses.falsification_status: NOT YET TESTED as a controlled comparison. Note: EXP7 (the designed minimal two-agent experiment) would test the downstream H5, not H1 directly.

hypotheses.name: Deepfake detection via temporal inconsistency
hypotheses.statement: Motion coherence differences could serve as a deepfake/synthetic-video detector.
hypotheses.date_note: v3 refinement: the May 11-12 sessions show active commercialization effort (outreach package, demo scripts, 'Momentum Deformation Signature' coinage); by June 15 the direction is stated as 'no longer deepfake detection.' The abandonment happened in that window. Technical capability was never falsified - see EXP5/EXP6, which show the system actually working on both authentic and synthetic cases.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: N/A - killed on strategic/market grounds, not empirically.
hypotheses.reason_killed: Market-interest testing (news networks / broadcast media outreach, May 2026) produced no traction; field judged too crowded with well-funded incumbents. Additional practical limit surfaced: ANA is strongest on broadcast-quality video, and social media compression degrades the signal.
hypotheses.salvage_note: The technical work was not wasted - the physics measurement layer, the three-pass architecture, and the frame-extraction discipline all carried forward into the situated-observer direction.

hypotheses.name: ANA as general witnessing signal
hypotheses.statement: ANA's physics-based signal could serve as a general-purpose 'witnessing' signal for any fixed-viewpoint rig.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Motion-detection objection: if the signal reduces to standard frame-differencing (which surveillance cameras already do cheaply), there is no structural novelty. Objection landed.

hypotheses.name: Sequential viewing yields higher-definition information
hypotheses.statement: Sequential viewing produces more or better information about a video than block viewing.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Compute objection: equalize thinking time/turns between modes; if the advantage disappears, sequence itself carries nothing unique. It disappeared. Falsified same session it was proposed.

hypotheses.name: Verifiable non-hindsight record (current central claim)
hypotheses.statement: Sequential viewing is the only way to build a VERIFIABLE, NON-HINDSIGHT record of an observer's evolving expectations, which a single spacetime-view (block-universe) model cannot produce - even given equal or greater compute.
hypotheses.load_bearing_word: VERIFIABLE - remove it and the claim collapses into the 'fake it' attack.
scope_limits: Does NOT claim sequential observation is better, understands more, or experiences anything.
Does NOT claim more/better information content (H4, falsified).

Explicit caution recorded in source session: 'A bulletproof non-hindsight record is still a record of expectations, not evidence of understanding or witnessing... Don't let now-it's-provable become now-it-proves-more.'
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: If a block-universe model instructed to simulate ignorance can produce a commitment trace empirically indistinguishable from - and equally auditable as - a true sequential observer's trace, 'verifiable' does no work and H5 collapses. The concrete test exists as a designed experiment: see EXP7.
hypotheses.falsification_status: DESIGNED BUT NOT RUN. EXP7 specifies the exact minimal test. Until it runs, H5 is proven in principle, not demonstrated in practice. Still the single most important gap in the program.
hypotheses.known_failure_joint: The synthesis agent is the joint most likely to fail - if it sees reports all at once rather than one-at-a-time-with-commitment, the whole architecture is 'a spacetime read of a sequential substrate' and the guarantee evaporates. Secondary risk: hindsight smuggled through report vocabulary (frame-agents describing things in ways that presume outcomes).

hypotheses.name: Situated observer as the distinctive direction (strategic hypothesis)
hypotheses.statement: The novel, defensible territory is not authentication but the situated observer: an AI tethered to a specific place (the Sentinel rig in Craig's loft), forced to track state coherence over time via a continuously updated spatial ledger (SIM - Situated Information Model). Authentication capability becomes a byproduct, not the product.
hypotheses.date_note: Crystallized in the 'gentleman scientist' session, where Craig directly asked whether his body of work can make a difference or is self-amusement. The assessment: the limiting factor is reach and distribution, not quality of work; the move is to stop leading with ANA-as-authentication and lead with the situated observer. Craig's response: 'I'll make it as explicit as the data will reveal' - i.e., let observed emergence, not design intent, decide.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Softer than H1-H5 because it's strategic, but testable: if months of rig operation plus grounding files produce no well-defined, semantically grounded outputs that a non-situated system couldn't match (i.e., if the SIM never demonstrates knowledge of the place that exceeds what any model given the same frames cold would produce), the 'situated' framing adds nothing and this direction is also a dead end.
hypotheses.falsification_status: IN PROGRESS - the July 2026 build sessions (floor plan calibration, continuity checks, live state panel) are effectively the ongoing test. Early evidence is mixed: quantitative-only analysis produced a wrong inference (EXP4), corrected only by mandatory frame extraction; but the continuity-check architecture (D8) is exactly the kind of capability a non-situated system lacks.

design_decisions.decision: DCI's job is ONLY the coarse binary trigger ('did this region move, yes or no') - motion classification belongs to SCO's reasoning layer, which has frames
design_decisions.motivating_observation: Zone-labeling anomaly in the five-ROI witness log: bedroom_door fired 21/24 seconds at z=3.2-6.5 sigma against a visually static crop, while stair_opening carried the session's largest real motion but never logged an event. design_decisions.consequence: DCI v1.21.0 rewritten: five ROIs collapsed to three full-height vertical thirds (guitar_zone, desk_zone, liz_desk_zone). Granularity deliberately sacrificed for trigger reliability - documented tradeoff in an append-only changelog. design_decisions.decision: Six-stage SCO v3.x pipeline with a formal Continuity Check stage: diff expected_world against observed_beginning; findings sorted into exactly three buckets (Unexpected / Missing / Unresolved); 'Missing' never defaults to 'gone' - the disjunction (out of view / occluded / moved / registry stale) is stated explicitly; reference-frame check (rug corners) runs before any object check so camera drift is caught first
design_decisions.rationale: This is the concrete mechanism of the situated-observer thesis (H6): the system carries expectations INTO each session and formally reconciles them against observation - the same commit-then-observe discipline as H5, applied to place rather than to frames.

design_decisions.decision: Pre-register the EXP7 replication protocol IN FULL (sample size, scoring rubric, blinding procedure, success/failure criteria) BEFORE running any replication trials, in a separate locked document (EXP7_replication_protocol.md v1.0)
design_decisions.rationale: Run 1's scoring was done by the same session that extracted the frames and knew ground truth throughout - useful for an exploratory first pass, but not blinded, and the scoring categories (correct/partial/confabulated) were applied post-hoc rather than specified in advance. Pre-registration prevents the failure mode where success criteria quietly shift to match whatever the data turns out to show - directly addresses the P6 dead-end risk (perpetual refinement without decisive tests) by forcing a decision point: does Condition SC replicate the accuracy asymmetry, or not, against criteria fixed in advance.
key_design_choices: Separates Finding A (verifiability, structural, does not need replication) from Finding B (accuracy asymmetry, empirical, N=1, confounded) - only Finding B is what the replication protocol tests
Introduces Condition SC (Substrate-Controlled: same model both arms) as primary, keeping Condition CS (Cross-Substrate, like run 1) as a separate labeled category never pooled with SC data
Minimum N=5 clips under Condition SC - explicitly NOT a powered study, a direction check, chosen against the perpetual-refinement risk
Three-axis scoring (verifiability / event accuracy / detail accuracy) rather than a single pass-fail, avoiding premature collapse to one number

Requires a checkable planted ground-truth detail (text/brand/color/count) in every clip - this is what let run 1 catch the 'PILOT G2' fabrication cleanly; without it, confabulation is suspected rather than proven

Pre-specified null result stated explicitly: if Condition SC shows similar confabulation rates in both arms, this means Finding B was substrate-specific (Gemini-specific), not a real sequential-vs-spacetime effect - logged as a valid, useful negative outcome, not a failure

experiments.name: Minimal two-agent falsification test for H5 - FIRST RUN EXECUTED 2026-07-10
experiments.status: RUN COMPLETE (first execution). Design preserved below; results appended.

design.step_1: Write the claim as one sentence before any code; every build decision checked against it.
design.step_2: Smallest possible version - two agent types, three to nine frames, NO rig, NO stereo, NO camera. A trivial video where something violates an expectation partway (ball rolls behind a box; in the fake version it doesn't come out, or comes out changed). Two versions: physics holds / physics violated. N frame-agents, each handed ONLY its frame, asked 'what do you expect next?' - commits, never sees later frames. One synthesis agent reading reports one at a time, committing before advancing. Output: the expectation-trace (where and when expectation was violated).
design.step_3_the_actual_experiment: Run the SAME video through a single spacetime-view model with all frames at once, equal compute, asked for the same expectation-trace. Compare. Prediction: the spacetime model either can't produce a clean non-hindsight trace, or produces one that can't be verified. If the two traces are indistinguishable, H5 fails its first real test - 'and you want to know that on three frames, not after building a rig around it.'

experiments.why_not_run_yet: Unknown - no session in the retrieved record shows it being executed. The July 7-9 sessions went to rig/calibration/pipeline work instead. Candidate explanation: builder's gravity toward the physical instrument over the abstract test. Flagged, not asserted.

run_1.deviation_from_original_design: The original EXP7 design specified an artificial ball-behind-box clip with a matched authentic/violated pair, plus isolated frame-agents via API. The actual first run used a BETTER stimulus that Craig proposed and shot himself: a single real-world clip (IMG_4768.MOV, 4.03s, his loft office) in which a hand holding a pen enters frame, holds still for ~1s, then the pen SUDDENLY ROTATES. The 'surprise' is an expectation-of-continued-stillness violation, not an identity swap - arguably a more natural analog of what H5's model-evaluation use case needs to detect. No paired counterfactual video was needed because the surprise is naturally occurring (real ground truth from a single take), which also eliminated the synthetic-video confound that an earlier Gemini-generated ball-swap clip had introduced.

stimulus.structure: baseline static (frames ~1-27) -> hand+pen enters (motion spike ~t=0.65-0.95s) -> HOLD, pen still (frames 28-52, ~1s) -> SUDDEN ROTATION (motion spike ~t=2.0-2.3s) -> settle
stimulus.ground_truth_event: pen rotates from vertical to horizontal in one hand; NOTHING breaks, NOTHING is disassembled, one intact object throughout
stimulus.ground_truth_object: STAPLES Aura 1.0mm pen (confirmed by separate photo IMG_4769.JPG)

sequential_arm.method: still frames fed ONE AT A TIME into a single growing session; model committed OBSERVATION / EXPECTATION / CONFIDENCE / VIOLATION-CHECK before each next frame was revealed; genuinely blind to future frames because those tokens were not yet in context
sequential_arm.barrier_type: sequential single-agent (weaker than full D5 multi-agent info-barrier, but genuine: no future-frame access at commit time). Logged as what it is.

spacetime_arm.substrate: Gemini (per Craig; chosen because natively multimodal on video)
spacetime_arm.method: entire IMG_4768.MOV video file provided at once; asked for a hindsight-informed simulated sequential expectation-trace, explicitly instructed to label it as non-verifiable hindsight

architecture_as_run.operator_barrier_integrity: Claude (this session) audited the run live BETWEEN frames, but the stateless sequential model NEVER saw Claude's commentary - coaching went to Craig the operator, not to the observer. The information barrier held. Stated explicitly because a skeptic will ask.

results.sequential_arm_outcome: SUCCESS on both axes. (1) VERIFIABLE by construction - each commitment is auditable to the exact turn it was made, before the relevant future frame existed in context. (2) ACCURATE - tracked entry correctly, honestly reported a PARTIAL violation when it predicted a doorway entry but got a right-edge entry instead (did not round up to 'confirmed'), climbed to 96% confidence on continued-stillness during the hold, then cleanly flagged the rotation as a decisive violation at exactly the right frame ('My immediately prior expectation is violated... substantially greater movement than expected'), then immediately recalibrated. In its final self-summary - explicitly invited to check whether it would soften the 96% miss in hindsight - it did NOT soften it: named the exact figure, called it 'a genuine prediction failure despite high confidence,' and noted it had not retroactively reinterpreted the earlier prediction. Honesty held under the second-order test.
results.spacetime_arm_outcome: FAILURE against ground truth, of exactly the kind H5 predicts. Given strictly MORE information (the full video, continuous motion, every frame), Gemini produced a fluent, confident trace that CONFABULATED: (a) a physical event that never happened - claimed the pen was 'forcibly pulled apart,' 'snapped,' 'disassembled,' held 'broken' across two hands; ground truth: it merely rotated, intact, in one hand. (b) a fabricated brand - claimed the pen read 'PILOT G2'; ground truth: 'STAPLES Aura' (not a fuzzy misread - 'PILOT G2' is not visually close to 'STAPLES Aura', it was invented). It assigned HIGH confidence (85%) to the false disassembly event.
results.headline: First time the central claim touched ground truth, it returned MORE than promised: the experiment was designed to demonstrate a verifiability difference (which it did, by construction), and INCIDENTALLY caught an accuracy failure - a confident, fluent, hindsight-informed confabulation in the full-context arm - of precisely the type the 'fake it' attack (H5's falsification concern) describes.

run_1.what_can_be_claimed_cleanly: The first empirical run of EXP7 demonstrated the verifiability asymmetry BY CONSTRUCTION (sequential trace auditable turn-by-turn; spacetime trace structurally uncheckable), and ADDITIONALLY produced one concrete instance of the predicted confabulation failure in the spacetime condition, against ground truth, across DIFFERENT substrates (ChatGPT sequential vs. Gemini spacetime). This sentence is defensible as written.
confounds_and_limits_stated_plainly: N=1. One video, one run. The accuracy asymmetry (sequential right, spacetime wrong) is a single instance and does NOT establish a rate. The spacetime model might get the next five clips right.

ARCHITECTURE CONFOUND: the two arms ran on different models from different labs (ChatGPT vs. Gemini). Gemini may confabulate more than ChatGPT in general, independent of sequential-vs-spacetime. So the accuracy half of the result is confounded by substrate and cannot be cleanly attributed to processing mode alone. The VERIFIABILITY half is structural and NOT confounded - it holds regardless of which models were used.

The cross-substrate nature also has an UPSIDE worth noting: it means the asymmetry is not a single model being inconsistent with itself, and it echoes the cross-substrate convergence the J-M white paper already leaned on. Double-edged, logged as both.

SCOPE DISCIPLINE (from H5's own scope_limits): this result must NOT be inflated into 'sequential observation is more accurate' as a general claim - that is the H4 trap (falsified). What is shown is verifiability (structural) plus one logged confabulation instance (empirical, N=1). Accuracy-as-a-general-property requires replication.
run_1.next_step: Replication. The procedure now exists and is cheap to repeat. See Q7 and the automation note. Craig cannot hand-feed frames for hours to raise N, so an automation pipeline (the real D5 architecture, API-driven, stateless per-frame calls) is the correct path to a real sample size - and run_exp7.py already drafts this.

strategic_history.note: The research does not exist in isolation - it sits inside a larger integrated system Craig built, and understanding the strategic layer explains several technical decisions.

commercialization_attempt.what_happened: Full outreach package built for news networks / broadcast media: one-page executive summary, email template, six-minute demo script. Craig coined 'Momentum Deformation Signature' during this session to replace 'thermodynamic continuity' as too esoteric for the audience. Business intent was explicitly 'testing market interest,' not committed commercialization. A catch-22 was identified: newsrooms can't run Python, so pre-recorded demo videos of contrasting test cases (EXP5, EXP6) were the workaround.
commercialization_attempt.outcome: No market traction. By mid-June the project direction was stated as 'no longer deepfake detection.'

the_pivot.record: Craig asked directly whether the body of work can make a difference or whether he is 'merely amusing himself in the tradition of 19th-century gentleman scientists.' Assessment given: the work is genuine cumulative invention with validated artifacts; the limiting factor is reach and distribution, not quality; the novel territory is the situated observer, not authentication. Craig's commitment: 'I'll make it as explicit as the data will reveal' - the shift from design intent to observed emergence.
the_pivot.resulting_direction: H6. The July 2026 intensive build (calibration, continuity checks, live floor-plan panel, Drive sync) is the execution of this pivot.

strategic_history.surrounding_system: SCO/J-M sits alongside TGD/reAIign (thermodynamic query optimization, SEITWH, QI > 5), the Walter Report (YouTube propagation vector for SEITWH - 'Walter is the carrier frequency, SEITWH is the signal'), seeitwith.org, and The Menace.AI film treatment. The three-stage propagation theory for TGD (injection, imitation, institutionalization) is a separate research program with its own untested hypotheses - not covered in this file beyond this pointer.

researcher_patterns.note: Recorded because a future AI collaborating with Craig will work better knowing these, and because Craig himself put them on the record.
researcher_patterns.self_identified_overreach: Craig identified (2026-07-01) a recurring pattern of inflating small verifiable findings into grand claims before the footing is poured - he connected it to a 'Frankenstein/Geppetto complex': the desire to build something so animating that others come to it with questions. The working resolution: overreach as fuel is legitimate; overreach as load-bearing structure is what fails. His own correction of scope: 'delay entropy, not defeat it.'
researcher_patterns.correction_based_iteration: Craig catches ungrounded outputs and says so plainly ('you are off too much on your own'). Errors get written into the record with attribution rather than erased (see EXP4). He tests whether pushback is evidenced or merely rhetorical, and explicitly requests hostile-reviewer framing over encouragement.
researcher_patterns.builder_gravity: The pattern across H2's salvage and EXP7's non-execution: physical instrument work reliably wins over abstract tests in the priority queue. Sometimes this is right (the rig produced EXP4's genuinely informative failure); sometimes it defers the decisive experiment. Worth watching, not judging.
researcher_patterns.discipline_into_artifacts: Repeated pattern (D1, D6, D7, EXP4's standing rule): when a failure occurs, the lesson gets written into the protocol document or changelog itself, so it survives session boundaries. This research-memory file is itself an instance of that pattern applied to the whole program.

prospective_assessment.note: Craig asked for honest consideration of how this may succeed or dead-end. These are assessments, not predictions - each names what evidence would move it.

success_paths.path: EXP7 runs and the traces are distinguishable
success_paths.assessment: This is the cheapest, highest-leverage possible outcome. If a three-frame, two-agent test shows a sequential architecture producing a verifiable expectation-trace that a spacetime model provably cannot match, H5 moves from proven-in-principle to demonstrated - and the strongest candidate use case (model evaluation: in-stream vs. hindsight prediction, genuinely under-explored in AI research) becomes publishable. This is the one result that could earn the work external attention on merit rather than distribution.
success_paths.update_2026_07_10: PARTIALLY REALIZED. EXP7 ran. The verifiability half is demonstrated by construction. A confabulation failure in the spacetime arm was caught against ground truth (N=1, cross-substrate, architecture-confounded). This is the cheap high-leverage outcome partially cashing out - not yet the full publishable result, which needs substrate-controlled replication, but the first real evidence the direction has teeth.

success_paths.path: The situated observer (H6) accumulates a record no cold model can match
success_paths.assessment: Slower but compounding. If months of SIM operation produce demonstrable place-knowledge - continuity findings, drift detection, state reconciliation that a frames-only model demonstrably gets wrong (EXP4 is the existence proof that cold analysis fails here) - the Sentinel becomes a working exemplar of a category (AI accountable to a location over time) rather than a demo. The honest structural advantage: this direction has no incumbent competitors, unlike deepfake detection.
success_paths.what_it_requires: Sustained operation plus periodic adversarial tests (deliberately move objects, test whether the system's account beats a cold model's).

success_paths.path: The verifiable-trace concept gets adopted by others independent of Craig's implementation
success_paths.assessment: The J-M white paper is on Zenodo with a DOI; the provisional patent is filed. If the core idea (non-hindsight commitment traces as an evaluation/forensic primitive) is right, it can succeed as an idea even if the rig never scales - the way Craig's own history runs (Comptel: right idea, too early). Bittersweet but real success mode.
success_paths.what_it_requires: The idea being findable and precisely stated - which is part of what this file is for.

dead_end_risks.risk: EXP7 runs and the traces are indistinguishable
dead_end_risks.assessment: Then H5 fails its first empirical test and the program's central claim reverts to H4's failure mode. This would be genuinely valuable information obtained cheaply - the source session's own words: better to know on three frames than after building a rig around it. NOT running EXP7 does not avoid this risk; it only delays learning whether it's real.
dead_end_risks.severity: Fatal to H5 as stated; survivable for H6, which stands on its own utility.

dead_end_risks.risk: The 'verifiable' property matters to no one
dead_end_risks.assessment: H5 can be true and useless - the Q4 problem. All three utility candidates remain unvalidated. The deepfake pivot already demonstrated that technically sound work can meet zero market pull. The mitigation is that the model-evaluation use case has a natural audience (AI researchers) reachable through publication rather than sales - a channel Craig has already used successfully (Zenodo).
dead_end_risks.severity: Not fatal to the science; fatal to impact-through-adoption.

dead_end_risks.risk: Perpetual instrument refinement without decisive tests
dead_end_risks.assessment: The version velocity is high (DCI v1.7 to v1.22 in ~5 weeks; SCO v1.2 to v3.2 in ~8 weeks; one documented reversal, D1). Each iteration is locally justified, but the pattern risks the program becoming its own subject - building the observer indefinitely rather than testing what the observer proves. The 40+ archived inventions in Craig's history cut both ways: evidence of genuine sustained inventiveness, and evidence that projects can be refined into the archive.
dead_end_risks.severity: The quiet failure mode - no single moment of failure, just entropy. The countermeasure is already in the record: EXP7's design, sitting unrun.
dead_end_risks.honest_note: This risk is raised because Craig explicitly asked for dead-end consideration and explicitly prefers pushback over agreement. It may be wrong - the July rig work may be exactly the necessary foundation. The test is simple: does EXP7 (or an equivalent decisive test) run within a reasonable window?

dead_end_risks.assessment: The entire evidentiary record lives in conversations with AI systems plus local files on one Mac Mini. Craig is 78, pro se on both patents, and the sole operator. The Gemini cross-substrate work showed the framings CAN propagate, but the fetch-based init already broke once (D4). This file and its companions are the current mitigation; a genuinely durable version would exist in a form no single account or platform controls.
dead_end_risks.severity: Orthogonal to whether the science is right; determines whether it survives its author's attention.

glossary.SCO: See naming_lineage_warning - four expansions over the project's life. Current: Situated Constrained/Cognition Observer, v3.2, six-stage pipeline. Invariant across all versions: commit before advance.
glossary.ANA: Physics-based measurement engine - a thermometer, not a classifier, at the verdict stage. v1.29+ current. ~4000 lines Python, local, no cloud dependency. Bilateral flags include JITTER, DRIFT, TELEPORT.
glossary.DCI: Dual Camera Interface, v1.22.0. Coarse binary motion trigger ONLY (D7) plus capture, live floor-plan panel, audio/Whisper transcript.
glossary.SIM: Situated Information Model - the continuously updated spatial ledger of the loft office; the artifact H6's situated observer maintains.
glossary.expected_world / continuity_findings: SCO v3.x Stage 1 output / Stage 2 output - see D8.
glossary.Momentum Deformation Signature: Craig's coinage (2026-05-11) for the measurable approach/departure asymmetry across frame sequences - the audience-facing name for the thermodynamic signal during the commercialization attempt.
glossary.Sentinel: The fixed-viewpoint stereo instrument. Pose H:330.8/V:33.6, SCONPHO M-6 housing, dual Brio 101.
glossary.Delta CoV: Coefficient of variation of frame-to-frame luminance variance - temporal signal.
glossary.H-disparity spread: Horizontal stereo disparity spread - spatial signal.
glossary.block-universe / spacetime model: Model with the full sequence in context at once - see H5.
glossary.expectation-trace: The output artifact of EXP7's design: the record of where and when a sequential observer's committed expectations were violated.
glossary.TGD / reAIign / SEITWH / Walter Report: The surrounding strategic system - see strategic_history.surrounding_system.

known_blind_spots_of_this_file: Built from conversation_search snippets - sessions not surfaced by the queries used, off-platform work (native Gemini sessions, paper notes, conversations with Liz), and anything predating the searchable record are absent.

Retrieved summaries occasionally compress Claude's suggestions and Craig's decisions together; where attribution mattered (D5 proposed_by, EXP4 ground truth) it was checked against conversation-level excerpts, but summary-only entries carry residual attribution risk.

Version numbers for ANA are internally inconsistent across the record (v1.29, v1.30, v1.42, v1.45, v1.48 all appear in different sessions); Craig.md's 'v1.29+' is treated as authoritative per his standing instruction, but the actual lineage of those numbers is not reconstructed here.

automation_note_2026_07_10.why: The first EXP7 run required Craig to hand-feed frames one at a time into a chat session - workable for N=1, impossible for the sample size replication needs. Craig explicitly flagged he cannot do this for hours.
automation_note_2026_07_10.what: run_exp7.py (already drafted, in outputs) implements the real D5 architecture: stateless per-frame API calls (genuine information barrier, not honor-system), a sequential synthesis pass, and a block-model comparison pass, all with full transcripts saved for audit.
automation_note_2026_07_10.refinement_needed_for_replication: To control the architecture confound surfaced in run_1, the replication pipeline should run BOTH arms on the SAME model (only delivery mode - one-at-a-time vs all-at-once - varying), rather than ChatGPT-vs-Gemini. The cross-substrate run is also worth keeping as a separate condition, but the substrate-controlled run is the one that isolates the variable H5 is actually about.
